title: Set the table

steps.text: Count how many people are eating.
steps.tip: Ask a grown-up if you are not sure.

steps.text: Put a plate at each seat.
steps.tip: Place it in the middle, a little back from the edge.

steps.text: Fork on the left, spoon or knife on the right, cup above.
steps.tip: Napkin goes under the fork or on the plate.

done_when: Every seat has a plate, cup, and utensils
Nothing is hanging off the edge
parent_notes: Skip knives for younger kids. Grown-up places glasses of water if they are full.
